objects.text: Elena Griffin
Healthcare Administrator
elena.griffin@emailfakes.com · (555) 893-2147 · LinkedIn.com/in/elenagriffinhealth · Cityville, State
SUMMARY

Results-oriented Healthcare Administrator with 7+ years managing hospital operations and improving patient care efficiency. Expert in team leadership, EHR implementation, and compliance adherence, delivering measurable operational improvements and cost savings in fast-paced healthcare settings.
EXPERIENCE
Healthcare Administrator — Rivermount Regional Medical Center
June 2019 - Present
• Led cross-functional team of 30+ staff in daily operations across three departments, improving patient flow and reducing wait times by 22%.
• Directed successful transition to an advanced Electronic Health Record system, increasing documentation accuracy by 35% and cutting administrative processing time by 28%.
• Implemented budget controls that reduced operational expenses by $320K annually without compromising patient care quality.
• Coordinated compliance audits leading to 100% regulatory adherence with zero citations over last 3 years.
Assistant Healthcare Administrator — Greenfield Community Hospital
August 2016 - May 2019
• Supported the management of clinical and administrative operations, contributing to a 15% improvement in patient satisfaction scores year-over-year.
• Streamlined vendor contract management, negotiating savings of $150K annually.
• Collaborated with clinical directors to develop staff training programs that improved team competency and reduced turnover by 12%.
• Assisted in quarterly budget forecasting and financial reporting improving forecast accuracy by 20%.
EDUCATION
Master of Health Administration (MHA), Westlake University, 2016
Bachelor of Science in Healthcare Management, Eastbrook College, 2013
SKILLS

Healthcare Operations Management  ·  Electronic Health Records (EHR)  ·  Regulatory Compliance  ·  Budgeting & Financial Analysis  ·  Team Leadership & Staff Development  ·  Patient Flow Optimization  ·  Contract Negotiation  ·  Quality Assurance
CERTIFICATIONS
• Certified Healthcare Administrator (CHA), National Healthcare Board, 2018
• Project Management Professional (PMP), Project Management Institute, 2020
LANGUAGES
English (Native), Spanish (Conversational)
